content.text:
This confirms it: this is a large refactor that consolidated separate reservation subclasses (`XGroupReservation`, `XCurriculumReservation`, `XCourseReservation`, etc.) into a single `XReservation` with a switch statement, and introduced the new `ApplicationProperty` fields for each type. During that consolidation, the Group/Curriculum/Course cases were all copy-pasted from the Individual case without updating the property names.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 18f154d85110c36f6eb403d0a33703db4cfe8175

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the full history of `XReservation.java` with `git log --follow -p --reverse`, scanning for the `case Group/Curriculum/Course` switch branches and `ReservationPriority*` property references to find where this switch logic first appeared.

**(2) The bug:** Commit `18f154d8` is a refactoring commit that merged several separate reservation classes (`XGroupReservation`, `XCurriculumReservation`, `XCourseReservation`, `XIndividualReservation`, `XDummyReservation`) into a unified `XReservation` class with a type-based switch statement, and added the corresponding per-type `ApplicationProperty` fields (`ReservationPriorityGroup`, `ReservationPriorityCurriculum`, `ReservationPriorityCourse`, etc.) in `ApplicationProperty.java` in that same commit. However, when writing the new switch statement, the `Group`, `Curriculum`, and `Course` cases were all copy-pasted from the `Individual` case and the type suffix (`Individual`) was never updated to match (`Group`, `Curriculum`, `Course`), even though the correctly-named properties already existed in the same commit.

**(3) Evidence:** The diff for `18f154d8` shows `ApplicationProperty.java` gaining 90 new lines including `ReservationPriorityGroup`, `ReservationPriorityCurriculum`, `ReservationPriorityCourse`, etc. — i.e., the correct properties were defined at the same time the bug was introduced, but simply never wired up in `XReservation.java`'s switch statement. This exactly matches the fix in `6eb8807d`, which only changes `Individual` → `Group`/`Curriculum`/`Course` in those three case blocks, with no new properties added — meaning the fix used properties that already existed, confirming they were just overlooked/mis-copied in `18f154d8`. No intermediate commit touched these specific lines between `18f154d8` and the fix `6eb8807d` (confirmed by the `git log --follow -p` trace showing the next touch to this file area is the fix commit itself).

I'm confident in this identification since the diff is a direct, isolated copy-paste error from a single commit, with no subsequent modifications to those lines until the fix.
